name: Possible structuring
description: 3+ cash deposits between 90% and 100% of the 10,000 threshold in a month

name: High cash volume
description: Cash deposits of 30,000+ in a month

name: Rapid movement of funds
description: 80%+ of outgoing value was received within the previous 24h, and 15,000+ sent

name: Fan-out burst
description: Payments of 1,000+ to 8+ counterparties within 72 hours

name: Fan-in burst
description: Receipts of 1,000+ from 8+ counterparties within 72 hours

name: High-risk jurisdiction exposure
description: 10,000+ sent to or received from a high-risk jurisdiction

name: Large flows on a new account
description: Account under 180 days old with 25,000+ incoming

name: Round-amount pattern
description: Half or more of 5+ transactions are round amounts of 1,000+
